stable.notes: Fix Jobs.cz microsite email autofill by adding semantic email-field detection using labels, placeholders, aria metadata and nearby field text. Diagnostics now include the email field source. Manual queue behavior and manual final Submit safety remain unchanged.

beta.notes: Desktop 2.6.1 fixes clipped and overlapping text in the narrow left settings panel. Search/Profile/Scoring forms now wrap long rows adaptively, Search checkbox labels are shorter while preserving full explanations in tooltips, and the window width remains compact. Branding from 2.6.0, duplicate-application protection, and manual final Submit safety remain unchanged.
